name: sample-custody
summary: An in-memory HTTP service for scientific specimen registration, custody transfer, and inspection batches.

workflows.name: Register a specimen
steps: validate the code, origin, quantity, and unit
store the specimen and append a registration audit event
workflows.success: returns a registered specimen with an identifier
workflows.failure: duplicate code or invalid quantity returns a client error
workflows.verification: POST /samples with a valid payload and inspect the registered response

workflows.name: Transfer specimen custody
steps: check the current holder and specimen lifecycle
append a transfer and update the current holder
workflows.success: returns the transfer and the new holder
workflows.failure: stale holder or sealed specimen returns a conflict
workflows.verification: POST /samples/{id}/transfers and GET the specimen history

workflows.name: Create and complete an inspection batch
steps: validate the selected specimens and create an open batch
complete the batch and seal every included specimen
workflows.success: returns a completed batch and sealed specimen count
workflows.failure: unknown, sealed, or already-batched specimens return a client error
workflows.verification: POST /batches, POST /batches/{id}/complete, and GET the manifest
